class_catalog.what: cloud systems colder than 245 K of at least 101 km in radius, July to September 1983 to 2007, 35 S to 35 N, detections of the MET satellite position alone

pooled_catalog.what: the same selection with the detections of every satellite position pooled, the catalog of the submitted paper

observed_slots.what: the 3-hourly July to September slots of 1983 to 2007 that the MET position observed

tracking_file.what: first steps of the convective-tracking families of the MET position, July to September 1984 to 2007
